period: Late Roman Republic / Early Roman Empire

birth.conversion_note: Date from Suetonius; September 23 (IX Kal. Oct.) well-attested

short_description_en: Augustus (63 BCE - 14 CE), born Gaius Octavius, adopted by Julius Caesar, was the founder of the Roman Principate and the first Roman emperor, ruling from 27 BCE until his death.
short_description_zh: 奥古斯都（前63-14年），原名盖乌斯·屋大维，被凯撒收为养子，为罗马元首制创立者和第一位罗马皇帝，自公元前27年统治至去世。
